test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held on: 3 Feb 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: What will be the amount (in ₹) of a sum of ₹ 6,000 in 2(1)/(4) years at 131over3% p.a. if the interest is compounded 9-monthly?
solution:
**Given:**

Sum = Rs. 6000

Rate = 131over3%

Time = 2(1)/(4) years

**Concept used:**

A = P(1 + R/100)T

Here,

A = amount

P = sum

R = rate

T = time

When

Interest is calculated on 9 monthly

Then

Rate = R × (9/12)

Time = T/9 [T in month form]

**Calculation:**

2(1)/(4) years = 27 months

T = 27/9 = 3

Rate = 131over3% or 40over3 for yearly

So, for 9 monthly it is 40over3 × 9over12 = 10%

Now,

A = 6000(1 + 10/100)³

⇒ 6000(1 + 1/10)³

⇒ 6000(11/10)³

⇒ 6000 × (1331/1000)

⇒ 7986

So, amount = Rs. 7986

**∴ The amount will be 7986 (in ₹).**
